index_name: Version-Constrained Dependency Test Index (min-version dependency resolution fixture)

plugins.name: MeshTools
plugins.author: Dino 8 Project
plugins.description: Same sample plug-in as plugin-index/index.json's meshtools entry (auto-loaded from next to the executable, reporting 1.0.0), but this index advertises 2.0.0 as the latest available - so a dependency requiring 1.5.0 or newer is not satisfied by the auto-loaded copy and must trigger a fresh install, while one requiring 9.9.9 can never be satisfied even by installing, since this index's own version is only 2.0.0.

plugins.name: CurveTools
plugins.author: Dino 8 Project
plugins.description: Depends on meshtools >= 1.5.0. The auto-loaded meshtools only reports 1.0.0, so installing this must (re)install meshtools fresh from this index - adding a second, independently-loaded MeshTools copy - rather than treating the stale auto-loaded one as already satisfied.

plugins.name: AnalysisTools
plugins.author: Dino 8 Project
plugins.description: Depends on meshtools >= 9.9.9, which this index cannot satisfy even by installing (its own meshtools entry is only 2.0.0) - a genuine version conflict. Installing this must fail cleanly and install nothing.
